description: DRAFT AGENT VISUAL REVIEW of ten real shots, not human-verified ground truth. Fixed four character criteria only, independent of monitor predictions and learned-rule checks. truePass=false means visibly contradicted continuity (drift is positive). Uncertain/occluded cells are omitted from boolean labels and recorded separately. Default evaluation must exclude every draft entry; no verifiedBy/verifiedAt fields are populated. Human review of these exact images is required before accuracy or improvement claims.
